question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Sporadic**
solution: The correct answer is: **Frequent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Sporadic"** means something that occurs at irregular intervals or happens only occasionally. (अनियमित / कभी-कभी होने वाला) • **Example:** The sporadic rain showers made it difficult to plan outdoor activities. • **"Frequent"** refers to something that occurs or happens often, regularly, or repeatedly. (बार-बार होने वाला) • **Example:** She is a frequent visitor to the library because she loves reading. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sporadic'** is **'frequent'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Frequent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Infrequent** (अकस्मात / कभी-कभार): Occurring rarely or not happening often. • **Example:** His visits to the town are infrequent due to his busy schedule. • **Occasional** (कभी-कभी / अवसरिक): Happening from time to time or at irregular intervals. • **Example:** She enjoys an occasional cup of coffee during her work breaks. • **Intermittent** (रुक-रुक कर / अनियमित): Occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady. • **Example:** The intermittent noise from the construction site disturbed the residents. 42:T99e, The correct answer is: **Morgue**.
